Quick-start prompts and formatted, easy-to-read answers

faqItems.question: How much does it cost to hire an AI developer?
faqItems.answer: The cost depends on the developer's expertise, the complexity of your project, the AI technologies involved, the engagement model and how long you need the developer. Instead of a one-size-fits-all price, we provide a project-specific estimate once we understand your requirements.

faqItems.question: What type of AI developers can I hire from Fillip Technologies?
faqItems.answer: You can hire Generative AI Developers, AI Agent Developers, RAG Developers, LLM Developers, AI Automation Developers, Machine Learning Engineers, Conversational AI Developers and AI Integration Developers, depending on what your product needs.

faqItems.question: What technologies do your AI developers work with?
faqItems.answer: Our AI developers work with AI models such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and Mistral AI; frameworks such as LangChain; backend technologies such as Python and Node.js; databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis; cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud; and integration tools such as n8n, Make and Zapier. The exact stack depends on your project.
